articles.title: Mighty Mike Plays Dad Says He Owns 'Like 12 Companies,' Promises Refunds for AI Shirts
articles.summary: Mighty Mike Plays dad Dave has promised refunds and issued a lengthy explanation after the internet demanded more information about the YouTube ads allegedly purchased by his son and the drama that followed.
body: The Mighty Mike Plays saga began when a father took to YouTube to announce that his son had allegedly used his company credit card to purchase more than $118,000 in video ads. It was a painful and highly relatable story that snowballed into a full-fledged internet spectacle when pricey AI-generated T-shirts and questionable details led many online to look for concrete answers.

The controversial father figure came clean in a new video titled " Allow me to Explain " that was uploaded to the Mighty Mike Plays channel last week (via Dexerto ). Dave started the hour-long explainer – which has since been deleted and re-uploaded on a new YouTube channel called Coffee Time with Dave – promising that everyone who purchased one of those T-shirts would receive a refund.

"Dave here. A.k.a. Devoted Dave. A.k.a. Dazzling Dave. A.k.a. Dependable Dave, and the list goes on," Dave said. "I want to give you guys an update: First off, I'm going to say that everyone that got a shirt got refunded whether they asked for it or not. So, whether you wanted a refund or not, you got it."

articles.title: Blindfolded Tekken 8 Player Achieves One of the Game’s Top Ranks from Beginner
articles.summary: Professional Tekken 8 player SuperBrine is going viral after reaching God of Destruction using Alisa while completely blindfolded with a sleep mask.
body: SuperBrine has been streaming his run on Twitch in the form of seven separate broadcasts, starting in June 2026. The final stream from this series, broadcast in early October, has become a hot topic within the fighting game community, as he was able to reach one of the game’s top ranks from Beginner while obscuring his vision with a sleep mask.

It’s an impressive feat no matter how you swing it, standing as a testament to SuperBrine’s skill as a player and Tekken 8’s laudable sound design — but, perhaps unsurprisingly, his blindfolded run from Beginner to God of Destruction has sparked no end of debate about the game's difficulty and Alisa’s ease of use as a character.

I got the chance to sit down with SuperBrine to discuss his self-imposed challenge and find out if it was legit or not. He confirmed that there was no way he was able to see through the sleep mask (which are typically made out of thick material with dense cushions on the eyes), and reiterated that he’d streamed his entire run live on Twitch for all to see, so there was no way for him to cheat.

articles.title: 10 Near-Perfect Nintendo Switch Games Nobody Played
articles.summary: When a system has a library as diverse as the Nintendo Switch, some great games are bound to go unrecognized. There are thousands of physical titles available, and thousands more that never got more than a simple digital release. Not every game is for everyone, though.
body: A weekly cheat sheet to what you’ll eventually love to play. No buying, no commitment — just saving for later.

Capcom originally released Shinsekai: Into the Depths as an Apple Arcade title, but someone at the company later decided to port it to Switch, where the game delighted the players who gave it a chance with thrilling underwater exploration. Players must monitor their oxygen reserves while navigating the labyrinthine ruins of past civilizations, also relying on assistance from a robot who isn’t all that helpful. Satisfying Metroidvania design and beautiful environments will keep you coming back, even if the game’s mobile roots do show from time to time. Learn to ignore them and you should do just fine.

articles.title: Blade Director Defends 'Good Dude' Kevin Feige After Marvel Scrapped Mahershala Ali's 1920s Vampire Movie
articles.summary: Blade director Bassam Tariq said he felt like a "failure" after exiting the Mahershala Ali-led Marvel movie, but he doesn't blame MCU mastermind Kevin Feige for how things went down.
body: The filmmaker, who was the first of two directors officially tied to Marvel Studios' now-canceled 1920s vampire movie, offered his honest thoughts about the project and even shared some new details about its story during an interview with Vulture. With a resume that includes films like 2012 documentary These Birds Walk, 2020's Mogul Mowgli, and last month's Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother, it seemed Blade is the movie that hit Tariq the hardest.

"I didn't know which way north was," he said of his Blade exit. "Afterward, I had to kind of disconnect from everybody. I don't know if that was the right thing to do, but it was one of those things where I had to find myself again. When you're doing it at that level, and it doesn't work out, you're like, 'S**t, I feel like a failure, because I couldn't do the thing that I wanted to do well.' You're trying to recalibrate who you are.

articles.title: ‘Lanterns’ Ending Explained: How the Finale Sets Up John Stewart in 'Man of Tomorrow'
articles.summary: The first episode of HBO’s Lanterns set up two big mysteries: What are extraterrestrials doing in Rushville, Nebraska, and who killed Hal Jordan (Kyle Chandler)? The season finale at long last reveals the truth about Hal’s death — along with more of Rushville’s secrets.
body: There has been plenty of speculation about who murdered Hal since his body was found in the stands of Rushville’s football stadium at the end of episode 1. However, episode 7 introduced the possibility that Hal might have shot himself in the head, following the sad “Jordan boys’ legacy” of his father and grandfather, who both died by suicide. But Hal actually seems very happy at the beginning of “Dirt and Stars,” where he’s hoping to take his relationship with Kerry Kane (Kelly Macdonald) to the next level by accompanying her to watch her son Noah (Shea Pritchard) play his last football game in Rushville.

Then someone sets Hal’s home on fire, and the former Green Lantern is trapped inside while trying to rescue his pet carnivorous plant Earl. Hal succumbs to smoke inhalation, but Noah rescues Hal from the fire and heals him with the same advanced technology Noah’s grandmother Zoe (Poorna Jagannathan) used on John Stewart (Aaron Pierre) in episode 5. Somehow, Earl also survives.

articles.title: HBO Officially Changes a Fundamental Rule of Green Lantern Canon
articles.summary: In HBO’s Lanterns, John Stewart (Aaron Pierre) spends his whole life preparing to become a Green Lantern. He seemingly abandons his destiny in episode 5, turning down the ring after becoming disillusioned with how the Guardians of the Universe treated the Manhunters and Hal Jordan (Kyle Chandler).
body: The Lanterns finale, “Dirt and Stars,” reveals that Sinestro (Ulrich Thomsen) forged a new Lantern on Antaan’s home planet. The planet’s air and water were contaminated by the Manhunter Zoe (Poorna Jagannathan), who unleashed a weapon that exposes people to their greatest fears and makes them suicidal. That fear manifests in yellow streaks in the Lantern.

“The Lantern Corp thinks that fear makes you weak,” Sinestro explains. “They couldn’t be more wrong. If harnessed correctly, fear can be the most powerful force in the universe. Fear is just evolutionary intelligence.”

The Halogram warns John not to use Sinestro’s Lantern to charge his ring, saying, “You don’t know what that Lantern might do.” But at the end of the episode, John uses the Lantern with a custom oath: “In brightest day, in darkest night, I embrace my fear, I’ll do what’s right. I choose this ring, I choose this fight, in service to this lantern’s light.” While he wants to use the power to protect Earth, John could be going down a very dark path.

articles.title: James Gunn Shuts Down Jensen Ackles Batman Casting Rumors
articles.summary: DC Studios co-CEO James Gunn has shut down rumors that Supernatural star Jensen Ackles has been cast as the DCU's Batman. Social media feeds caught fire over the weekend when comic book fans learned that The Boys alum had recently followed the DC movie bigwig on Instagram.
body: Gunn poured cold water on the recently reignited rumors over on his preferred social media platform, Threads, when replying to a post covering the subject earlier today. He said he had no idea Ackles had dropped him a follow and that he was "going to follow him back." Sadly, that's about the extent of their interactions over the years.
"Thanks for letting me know," Gunn said. "I'm going to follow him back. I met him once 20 years ago when he was dating a friend of mine. Nice guy. We haven't cast him as anything yet."

While the "yet" in that sentence might give some hope, any dreams that the actor might play Batman have been put to rest, at least for now. Fans have long named Ackles as their pick to play the Caped Crusader in some form for a few reasons, including the fact that he already doesn't look half bad wearing the Batsuit.

The Dean Winchester actor has famously suited up in full Batman gear before and even made IGN's list for best celebrity Halloween outfits in 2019. He wears the cowl well, but he's proven to have the gruff vocals required for the part, too.

articles.title: 10 Essential Sega Genesis Games Still Missing From Nintendo Switch Online
articles.summary: Players who subscribe to Switch Online know that it comes with a wide variety of retro games from past Nintendo consoles such as the NES and SNES. If they opt to spend more for the Expansion Pass, they get access to games that appeared on additional hardware, including the Sega Genesis.
body: For a brief time there, Interplay was riding high on a brief series of personality-driven game releases. One of the wilder ones of the bunch was Boogerman: A Pick and Flick Adventure, which featured a comic superhero type who subdues his enemies with burps, farts, and boogers. The game relied heavily on gross-out humor, but featured competent platforming action to go with it, as well as vividly drawn characters who sold the joke. If you can look past the humor, you’ll find a solid experience that spans more than 20 levels, complete with puzzles and bosses. Nintendo made the game available on Virtual Console in 2008, but it hasn’t been seen since.

articles.title: Dynasty Warriors producer would rather make new games than more remasters
articles.summary: Dynasty Warriors producer Tomohiko Sho says he'd rather spend what's left of his career making new games than more remasters of his old ones.
body: Sho isn't ruling future remasters out entirely, but he's not volunteering for the job either. Asked by 4Gamer (machine-translated) about the prospect shortly after Dynasty Warriors 3 Complete Edition Remastered launched on Switch 2, PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S, he made it clear that whether or not the series gets another remaster depends on how well this release performs, and hinted he'd personally prefer not to be the one making it.
"I can't say anything at the moment, and I haven't even thought about it, but it's not impossible that we'll remaster titles that aren't available on Steam," he said (thanks, IG ).

"However, to be honest, I don't want to do it. It would be almost a complete remake, and even this time I sometimes thought, 'Why am I remaking something I made myself?' I'm in my fifties now, and I sometimes think about 'how many more games can I make before I retire', so I'd rather make new games or sequels."

However, he's not against future remasters, either. Sho says he still feels an obligation to the fans who want more remasters, and hints he may hand the job to someone else on the team while he gets on with new games and sequels.

articles.title: Modders are furious as Claude-powered mashup mods flood social media
articles.summary: Long-time mod makers are not happy about the latest trend to take over their corner of the internet - the "bullshit 'trend'" of AI-generated, or "vibe-coded", mods.
body: As first reported by IGN, the backlash is building after a number of modders - including some who openly admit to using generative AI to help write their mods - opened up about mashup mods splicing entirely unrelated games together.

"I mod games and I'm not shy about the fact that I use AI to do it. I hate this bullshit 'trend'. Pure slop, there's nothing creative about this at all," modder kran27_ posted, adding that "the shit that's getting the clicks is this jingling keys bullshit".
Another, discountmodder, added: "If this becomes the permanent state of modding, this may be my last project. I don't wanna be involved in an AI slop-factory".

What's got them so riled up is the huge surge of mods that bring unrelated games together, from World of Warcraft into Call of Duty: World at War, to Escape From Tarkov into Skyrim, and a version of Insomniac's Spider-Man that lets you swing around Batman: Arkham City 's Gotham.

articles.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance studio co-founder says a lot of RPGs are 'still games for teenagers,' and that he's 'tired of all the RPGs where you are this chosen one'
articles.summary: In a recent interview with PC Gamer's Joshua Wolens, Warhorse Studios co-founder Martin Klima traced the inspirations for Kingdom Come: Deliverance back to boredom with the typical RPG—kill the dark lord, romance a companion or two, and so on.
body: "I play a lot of RPGs, it's a genre I really like," he said. "I was really and I still am bored and tired of all the RPGs when you are this chosen one, when you have this grand task of saving the universe.. The games that are these really straightforward power fantasies. It's not that I think it's somehow wrong in principle. There is nothing bad about a good power fantasy. It's just, it's so repetitive."

He likened the typical fantasy roleplaying game to the old idler Progress Quest, a satire which lampooned EverQuest and its ilk for being time vampire-Skinner boxes. "It's really a distillation of what the common RPG is. So I found that there must be many, many people who are really tired of this formula and who want something new and different," he said. That formed the seedling which eventually germinated into KCD.

articles.title: PlatinumGames boss hints he wants to expand Bayonetta as Stellar Blade director calls the series "indispensable"
articles.summary: PlatinumGames president Atsushi Inaba has hinted he'd like to expand the character of Bayonetta and broaden her world.
body: While he stopped short of confirming a new game, Famitsu reports that when Inaba sat down with Shift Up CEO and Stellar Blade director Kim Hyung-tae during Tokyo Game Show held to mark a crossover bringing four Bayonetta-themed costumes to Stellar Blade Complete Edition on Switch 2 this November, he admitted he still had a desire to expand the franchise further.

Kim used the opportunity to gush about the series himself, calling Bayonetta "an indispensable work in my life" (albeit via machine-translation) and naming it one of his three favourite games, while admitting he had to control himself while designing his own Bayonetta-inspired "Black Dress" costume so it wouldn't go too far. He even asked, half-joking, to design characters for the next entry himself.
Asked directly about that next entry, Inaba declined to give specifics, telling Famitsu only to wait and see.

It's certainly more optimistic than recent conversations - series creator Hideki Kamiya left Platinum in October 2023, saying at the time he'd envisioned Bayonetta as a nine-part saga he may now take "to the grave" with him - and Bayonetta 3 director Yusuke Miyata has also since departed.

articles.title: What does your dream videogame concert look like?
articles.summary: It feels like the last few years have seen a huge upsurge in videogame concerts, at least over here on British soil anyway. Undertale, The Legend of Zelda, Stardew Valley, The Witcher 3, Sonic, Metaphor: ReFantazio, Final Fantasy. The list goes on and on!
body: It's been a heartwarming sight—despite my saltiness at half of them happening in London, a city that is both too far away for a casual evening and also far too London for me to willingly set foot in it more than twice a year—but I still yearn to see more of my favourite songs in a live setting.

So it got me thinking, what would my ultimate videogame concert actually look like? Well, I'd probably be chucking in a whole lot of Square Enix nonsense a la Distant Worlds—give me Final Fantasy 10, FF12, FF14, and a little bit of FF13 on the side—but I would also kill to hear some Kingdom Hearts stuff with a live orchestra.

Then I'd probably take a pivot away from JRPGs entirely to hear some songs from my childhood. I continue to be utterly obsessed with the soundtrack from Rare's Kameo: Elements of Power 20 years after I first played it, and it's the kind of music that absolutely deserves the full orchestral treatment. And to wrap it all up? Chuck in a DJ set full of remixes from some classic Tekken games. Is that a major tonal shift? Yes, but it's my dream videogame concert, not yours. Get your own!
points: It feels like the last few years have seen a huge upsurge in videogame concerts, at least over here on British soil anyway.
Undertale, The Legend of Zelda, Stardew Valley, The Witcher 3, Sonic, Metaphor: ReFantazio, Final Fantasy.

Yes, but it's my dream videogame concert, not yours.

articles.title: RuneScape is getting a new character type that promises a fresh start, but existing players are wary of splitting the community up
articles.summary: It's very easy to look at RuneScape Reignited's announcement blog or fancy trailer and assume it's a new upgraded version of the classic game—it certainly walks and talks like one, not dissimilar to the upcoming World of Warcraft: Forever.
body: In fact, some of them have wheeled out the dragon-headed cannons for one of those Falador riots. People have gotten their yuks in: on X, PhosaniNex posted, "All 100 RS3 players in attendance for the final riot to end all riots, what a sight."

So, what is a Reignited character? Well, they'll all begin play with no progress and share an isolated economy, but they'll be able to play on existing worlds or new, Reignited-exclusive ones. Reignited and regular players can hang out together and form a clan, but they can't fight the same bosses or trade with one another. A dev blog states there will be no new updates exclusive to these new characters, and once you've selected a character type you can't switch.

In other words, it's sort of like creating an Ironman character, but not quite as lonely. While the announcement page promises the chance to play without unpopular systems like Treasure Hunter, that move away from microtransactions was actually announced at the start of this year. Rather than an overhaul unto itself, this seems more like a push to get new people trying RS3 without the fear of being 20 years behind on everything.

videos.summary: The 2026 World Series has now passed its halfway mark, with Round 3 taking place in Singapore.
body: In the previous Round in Tokyo, reigning champion José Serrano dominated the race right up until the final lap, only to drop to 5th place due to a costly penalty. This dramatic turn of events has significantly impacted the Points Ranking, in a race where the all the Spaniards were expected to hold the advantage.

Will current leader Kylian Drumont, fresh off his victory in the chaotic Round 2, build momentum to pull away from the pack? Will the Spanish drivers stage a comeback? Or will Valerio Gallo, who has been biding his time and closing in on the leaders, finally launch a serious charge?
With the World Finals fast approaching, the battle for the Nations Cup is becoming increasingly unpredictable. Witness how the competition unfolds!
